baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence 'came upon his shirt with false blood' and the closing 'what you describe.'
baseline_models.mechanism: A brought covering carries a blood-red mark, but the falsehood inventory includes a cloth that lies by its condition and description displays a thing through attributed features. Object and account therefore form one fabricated witness.

activation_trace.role: Bringing and presenting a thing makes the shirt-and-blood complex an intentionally staged exhibit.
The worn covering supplies the material surface on which the claim is made visible.
Blood-red coloration supplies the exhibit's immediately legible bodily mark.
A colored or patterned cloth that lies by its condition turns falsehood into a material display.
Displaying a thing through its attributes links the staged surface to the brothers' verbal rendering.

changed_reading.before: The brothers accompany a verbal lie with a bloody shirt.
changed_reading.after: They make the shirt function as a visual sentence whose blood-color describes a death that did not occur.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: 'Rather, your selves have made an affair attractive to you.'
baseline_models.mechanism: Inner appetite decorates a proposal, the self's inward faculty rehearses it, and counsel hardens it into an affair. The accusation diagnoses a production process, not a momentary impulse.

activation_trace.role: Self-adornment makes the false course appear attractive and manageable from within.
The inward faculty of thought and apprehension is the chamber in which the proposal is normalized.
Consultation and managed opinion turn decorated desire into a deliberated affair.

changed_reading.before: The brothers were tempted into a bad deed.
changed_reading.after: An appetite decorates a proposal, rehearses it as counsel, and converts it into a chosen affair; the lie is downstream of self-persuasion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: 'So, beautiful patience; and Allah is the one whose help is sought against what you describe.'
baseline_models.mechanism: Patience restrains reactive grief, beauty qualifies that restraint as an enacted good, and sought aid relocates effective agency. The description-without-sight branch makes this a disciplined withholding of assent under evidentiary pressure.

activation_trace.role: Holding the self back from panic supplies the response's active discipline.
Beauty in action governs the manner of restraint rather than decorating suffering.
Seeking effective assistance transfers action from immediate retaliation to divine aid.
A transaction conducted by description without sight sharpens the pressure to accept an unseen event on supplied terms.

changed_reading.before: Jacob resigns himself consolingly to a painful report.
changed_reading.after: He contains reaction, withholds assent to an unseen rendering, and actively seeks help without prematurely closing the case.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening frame makes visible signs, disclosure by sign or speech, and trace-following the proper modes of reading. The bloodied cloth imitates that economy while lying by its surface, so the focus becomes a contest between a sign and a counterfeit sign.

activation_trace.role: A visible sign establishes the evidentiary mode that the displayed shirt later imitates.
Disclosure through speech or sign requires a warranted passage from appearance to meaning.
Following a trace supplies the counter-method to consuming the brothers' exhibit at face value.
The lying cloth makes the visible token itself capable of misdirection.
Description binds the material token to the account whose meaning it is meant to disclose.

structural_cues: The sign, clear-book, and traced-story frame precedes a focus scene built around an exhibited object and closes with 'what you describe.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible sign, disclosure, trace-following, and a cloth that lies by appearance; I infer that a genuine sign should survive trace-testing. A live alternative is that the opening frame is literary orientation rather than a forensic instruction.

changed_reading.before: The shirt is a fabricated witness inside the episode.
changed_reading.after: The shirt is a counterfeit sign inside a discourse of signs, and Jacob's 'rather' performs trace-reading against its offered surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: A true dream is repeatedly seen and then withheld from hostile narration, whereas the alleged wolf event is unseen and offered for acceptance through description and a lying cloth. Truth is protected by restricting circulation; falsehood seeks force by overproducing representation.

activation_trace.role: Repeated dream-seeing supplies a truthful visual channel before the brothers' manufactured display.
The split branch of transmitted report exposes how a seen thing changes status when put into circulation.
The prohibition on recounting protects the true vision from becoming actionable news among hostile hearers.
Description without sight frames the brothers' demand as assent to an unseen transaction.
The cloth that lies by its condition supplies false seeing in place of the absent event.

structural_cues: The dream is seen in 12:4, its telling is restricted in 12:5, and the brothers later narrate an event no addressee witnessed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies true vision, restricted recounting, description without sight, and a deceptive cloth; I infer a contrast between protected truth and coercive representation. Alternatively, dream and forensic report may simply be different narrative modes.

changed_reading.before: The brothers support an unseen claim with a physical prop.
changed_reading.after: They ask Jacob to purchase an unseen event by description, while the earlier truthful vision gained protection precisely by not entering hostile circulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The grievance over paternal love binds a mutually supporting group; removal promises to empty the father's attention for them, and future righteousness launders the act as temporary. Their later resolved determination and the phrase 'their affair' expose the full social mechanism behind self-adornment.

activation_trace.role: Love lodged in the heart supplies the scarce value around which the brothers organize desire.
A group that surrounds and mutually supports converts private resentment into coalition confidence.
Emptying a place supplies the imagined causal gain: Yusuf's removal clears paternal attention.
The father's face and future-facing attention become the object the coalition seeks to monopolize.
Promised righteousness after the deed supplies moral repair as a device for making the present act tolerable.
Gathering dispersed opinion into firm resolve shows the decorated proposal becoming executable group will.
The later label 'their affair' resolves through the focus inventory as the product of consultation and managed opinion.
Self-adornment names the process that converts jealous value, coalition support, and deferred repair into an attractive plan.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from unequal love, to collective strength, to removal for exclusive attention, to promised later righteousness, and finally to resolved action called 'their affair.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the grievance, coalition, desired vacancy, deferred righteousness, resolve, and affair; I infer the arrow from desired outcome through moral temporization to action. A live alternative is that different brothers share the deed without sharing one fully integrated motive.

changed_reading.before: Their selves make one bad act seem attractive.
changed_reading.after: A coalition launders jealous desire through group strength and promised future reform until a wished-for vacancy becomes a deliberated affair.

context_deltas.mechanism: The person is thrown into a place that removes him from sight and is expected to be picked up elsewhere; his detachable covering is then brought home. Concealment and transport of the body create the evidentiary vacancy that the shirt occupies as surrogate.

activation_trace.role: Throwing a thing until it lies cast supplies the body's violent removal from its familial place.
Picking up what lies cast projects a second trajectory for Yusuf beyond the brothers' custody.
A low place in which something disappears makes bodily absence an engineered condition.
The unlined cut well supplies the concrete cavity that receives and hides the person.
The removed person's detachable covering becomes the visible remainder available for return.
Bringing a thing home completes the substitution of exhibited garment for absent body.

structural_cues: The proposed concealment and pickup in 12:10 is enacted in 12:15; the body remains absent while its shirt arrives in 12:18.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies casting, disappearance, a well, projected pickup, and a returned shirt; I infer that the garment is made to substitute evidentially for the body. Alternatively, it may function only as one supporting prop rather than a full surrogate.

changed_reading.before: The shirt supports the claim that an absent body was killed.
changed_reading.after: The plot first manufactures bodily absence, then installs the detachable shirt in that vacancy as a portable surrogate witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before custody, the brothers solicit calm trust and describe themselves as pure counselors and guards; after failure, they pre-frame disbelief even under truth. The focus's 'what you describe' therefore reaches beyond the wolf report to the trustworthy identities they have repeatedly asserted.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling trust is the disposition the brothers explicitly solicit before receiving custody.
Purity from fraud supplies the self-description that their later staged evidence reverses.
Guarding and watching names the role they claim and then narratively fail.
Belief that settles the heart becomes the very response they preemptively say Jacob will withhold.
Their conditional appeal to truthful speech inoculates the report by making rejection look prior and indiscriminate.
Description encompasses both the narrated event and the moral attributes the speakers assign themselves.

structural_cues: Claims of trustworthiness, unmixed counsel, and guardianship precede custody; the final report then anticipates disbelief even if its speakers were truthful.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the role-claims, failed custody, and preemptive truth conditional; I infer retrospective inversion and rhetorical inoculation. A live alternative is that the earlier claims are ordinary persuasion and the final line merely acknowledges already damaged trust.

changed_reading.before: Jacob rejects the brothers' description of what happened to Yusuf.
changed_reading.after: He also rejects their manufactured self-description as trusted counselors, guardians, and truth-tellers, the social warranty on which the event-description depends.

context_deltas.mechanism: Jacob first supplies the feared predator scenario and ties it to the brothers' inattention; they answer that such an outcome amid their surrounding group would make them losers, then report exactly that outcome. The account recycles his forecast while violating their own plausibility claim.

activation_trace.role: Fear that anticipates a hated event supplies the wolf scenario before the brothers narrate it.
The predatory wolf gives the anticipated threat a memorable and reusable agent.
Inattention that leaves a thing outside vigilance supplies the condition attached to Jacob's fear.
A mutually supporting surrounding group makes the feared loss implausible by the brothers' own boast.
General loss names the consequence they themselves attach to failure under those conditions.
Reappearance of the same predator converts Jacob's forecast into the report's central alibi.
Falsehood marks the recycled scenario and its supporting blood as contrary to the actual event.

structural_cues: Jacob voices the wolf scenario in 12:13, the brothers call its occurrence amid their group a loss in 12:14, and they report that exact occurrence in 12:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forecast, vigilance condition, group boast, loss criterion, and exact repetition; I infer purposeful reuse plus internal contradiction as abductive grounds for rejection. Alternatively, the feared event could occur despite sincere overconfidence.

changed_reading.before: Jacob somehow recognizes a plausible wolf report as false.
changed_reading.after: His 'rather' can arise abductively: the report appropriates his own fear and requires the brothers to inhabit the very loss they had just declared incompatible with their group strength.

context_deltas.mechanism: Inside the hidden deed, secret knowledge promises a future report while the perpetrators do not perceive. At narrative level, divine aid against their present description is not empty waiting; a concealed counter-report already exists and has a future path to disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge cast in secrecy inserts a protected truth-channel inside the concealed event.
A report that comes and is delivered gives hidden knowledge a promised future public form.
Fine awareness, here negated for the perpetrators, establishes the asymmetry between their action and the truth already carried within it.
Sought assistance lets the response remain active while the counter-report is not yet available.
Their present description is held against a different report whose disclosure has been promised.

structural_cues: The secret communication and promise that Yusuf will report 'their affair' occur within the well episode before the brothers return with their account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies revelation to Yusuf, future report, perpetrator unawareness, and sought aid; I infer a narrative-level counter-channel grounding patience. It does not establish that Jacob knows the revelation's content, so his own epistemic position may remain unresolved.

changed_reading.before: Beautiful patience waits for unspecified divine assistance against a lie.
changed_reading.after: At narrative level, patience holds space for a concealed truth-channel already oriented toward future testimony, without granting Jacob detailed access to it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The brothers time their arrival for diminished visibility, lead with crying, and then present red-marked cloth. Darkness, affect, and object combine into a multisensory persuasion sequence that tries to move the hearer before scrutiny begins.

activation_trace.role: Arrival with something to present begins the deliberately ordered encounter.
Evening darkness and reduced clarity weaken visual inspection of the coming exhibit.
Performed crying supplies an affective frame that pressures interpretation before evidence is assessed.
Blood-red color gives the low-visibility encounter a vivid and emotionally loaded mark.
The cloth that lies by its condition completes the visual component of the performance.

structural_cues: The return is sequenced as evening arrival, crying, verbal report, and then presentation of the marked shirt.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reduced visibility, a branch for affected crying, and false blood; I infer coordinated affective camouflage. The materially live alternative is mixed or genuine distress even while the report and exhibit are false.

changed_reading.before: A false sentence is supported by a false object.
changed_reading.after: The lie is staged as an encounter: low visibility limits inspection, tears preload sympathy, and the colored shirt supplies the final sensory proof.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the activation comes from the packet's split mapping of ع و ن to ع ي ن, not from the ordinary derivation of 'the one whose help is sought.' It remains anchored at word 15 and gains force from the explicit contrast with description without sight; downstream prose should render it only as an imagistic echo of witnessing and care, never as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: 'Allah is the one whose help is sought against what you describe,' with ع و ن carrying a packet-provided ع ي ن target.

activation_trace.role: Eyewitness seeing supplies an exploratory counter-image to the brothers' account of an event no addressee saw.
Description without sight makes the need for a witnessing counter-position especially sharp.
The earlier field of seeing by eye or insight keeps witnessed knowledge active within the pericope.

changed_reading.before: Divine aid is sought against an untrusted description.
changed_reading.after: Alongside aid, the split-root field evokes an ultimate eyewitness position from which unseen description can be answered by seeing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The stopper branch of ص ب ر is materially distant from ethical patience, so this is not a proposed gloss. It remains valid as a cross-domain activation because the focus word 'patience' answers an episode centered on a cut well; downstream prose should qualify it as an image of sealing and containment, not philology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: 'So, beautiful patience' answers the concealment of Yusuf in the well.

activation_trace.role: A stopper that seals a vessel or well turns patience into an image of containing what might otherwise spill out.
The cut unlined well supplies the concrete cavity to which the distant sealing image attaches.
Concealment from eyes gives containment a temporal purpose until the hidden fact can emerge.
Beauty of action keeps the sealing image ethical rather than merely suppressive.

changed_reading.before: Patience restrains grief while Yusuf remains absent.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, patience seals the mouth of the very kind of cavity that hides Yusuf, containing grief without treating concealment as resolution.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Taking night as a camel is a branch-distant image of ج م ل and cannot replace the adjective's ordinary force. It remains anchored because 'beautiful' directly follows patience and the brothers arrive at evening; downstream prose may use it as a qualified metaphor for traversing darkness rather than standing inert within it.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: 'Beautiful' in 'beautiful patience' follows an evening arrival engineered around obscurity.

activation_trace.role: Taking night as a mount activates patient movement through darkness rather than static endurance.
The explicit time of evening gives the distant night-journey image a local temporal anchor.
Restraint of panic governs how the dark interval is traversed.

changed_reading.before: Beautiful patience remains steady during a dark report.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it rides through the imposed night, preserving direction and agency until obscurity gives way.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The activation uses the packet's non-dominant د م ي target for the QAC root د م و, so it is not a claim that the surface word means 'image.' It remains anchored in the blood applied to a garment and the pericope's true dream-image; downstream prose should describe a pictorial resonance, not an alternative translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The blood on the shirt depicts the absent body's supposed fate.

activation_trace.role: The fashioned image branch makes the applied blood resonate as a picture of an absent body rather than residue from it.
The garment-cover supplies the surface on which that substitute body-image is displayed.
A cloth that lies by its visual condition marks the image as counterfeit.
The true dream-image supplies a contrasting representation whose truth does not depend on staged bodily residue.

changed_reading.before: False blood is a forged physical trace.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is also an applied picture of the missing body, a counterfeit image set against the pericope's truthful dream-image.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The wild animal that runs and then stops to look behind is an idiomatic branch of ك ذ ب, not the ordinary sense of falsehood here. The race and wolf alibi give it a visible local mechanism, so it is worth retaining as a kinetic reading; downstream prose should mark it as wordplay about retrospective scrutiny, not event reconstruction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: 'False blood' follows a report built from racing and a predatory animal.

activation_trace.role: A wild creature that runs, halts, and looks behind gives falsehood a kinetic pattern that fails under retrospective inspection.
Racing supplies the report's forward rush and its attempt to get ahead of questioning.
Agitated movement in changing directions links the animal alibi to instability under review.
The account's descriptive surface is what Jacob forces to stop and face backward toward its own sequence.

changed_reading.before: The brothers' account advances quickly from race to wolf to blood.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the lie runs ahead but then stops and looks back, where recycled fear and prior boasts expose its unstable track.

strongest_changes: The shirt becomes a visual sentence and counterfeit sign, not merely an accessory to speech.
Self-adornment expands into a social mechanism that launders jealous desire through coalition strength and promised later reform.
The wolf report becomes abductively rejectable because it recycles Jacob's fear and contradicts the brothers' own stated loss condition.
Beautiful patience becomes disciplined non-assent sustained by aid and, at narrative level, by a concealed future counter-report.
summary.what_was_special: Material, epistemic, and social branches converged: an absent body was replaced by a lying surface, role-claims supplied the report's warranty, and split or distant branches preserved live images of witnessing, sealing a well, traversing night, and picturing a body.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not state whether Jacob's rejection depends on close physical inspection, narrative inconsistency, insight, or several of these together.
The secret communication in 12:15 is to Yusuf; it grounds the reader's counter-report but does not show that Jacob knows its content.
The evening crying may be calculated performance, mixed distress, or both.
The ع ي ن and د م ي split-target readings and the well-seal, night-mount, and kinetic-falsehood branches are exploratory activations, not lexical replacements.
